headline: Track projects, invoices, and revisions with ease
features: Track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds using Notion and Google Sheets
Bilingual Arabic and English support for local freelancing habits
No subscriptions, no client data collected
Simple templates for Notion and Google Sheets
Helps manage multiple clients without stress

faq.q: What is included in the template pack?
faq.a: The template pack includes Notion and Google Sheets templates for tracking client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
The templates are available in Notion and Google Sheets formats.

faq.q: Can I use the templates for multiple clients?
faq.a: Yes, the templates are designed to help manage multiple clients efficiently.

faq.q: Does the product collect client data?
faq.a: No, the product does not collect any client data.
The templates are available in Arabic and English to support local freelancing habits.
